name: Stomp

boost.name: Reach
effect: +0-1 Range.
NOW: Strike.
HIT: Push 2. You may remove an Ice Spike from a space occupied by or adjacent to the opponent. If you do, gain Advantage.

name: Shovel Charge

boost.name: Shattering Stomp
effect: Place Ice Spikes onto any 2 spaces (occupied or unoccupied).
BEFORE: Close 2.
HIT: Draw a card, then Push up to 2. Draw a card for each Ice Spike the opponent is pushed onto during this movement.

name: Shovel Slam

boost.name: Dashing Through
effect: Advance or Retreat up to 6. Remove the first 2 Ice Spikes you move onto.
HIT: You may remove an Ice Spike from a space adjacent to the opponent to Push or Pull 1.
AFTER: Place an Ice Spike in a space adjacent to you (occupied or unoccupied).

name: Polar Plow

boost.name: Powerful Blow
effect: +2 Power.
NOW: Strike.
-1 Power for each Ice Spike between you and the opponent.
BEFORE: If the opponent is at the edge of the arena, you may move an Ice Spike onto their space.
AFTER: Close 3.

name: Shovel Drop

boost.name: Avalanche
effect: Move an Ice Spike up to 3 spaces, then you may spend 1 Gauge. If you do, take another action.
Ignore Armor.
Opponents cannot move you.
BEFORE: Place an Ice Spike in your space, then Advance 2 or 3.
HIT: Push or Pull 1.

name: Icicle Drop

boost.name: Rebuild
effect: Draw 2 cards. You may remove 1 or more Ice Spikes from the arena to draw that many additional cards, then add this card to your Gauge.
Stun Immunity.
This attack only hits if the opponent's space contains an Ice Spike.
AFTER: Advance up to 3.

name: Snow Slash

boost.name: Block and...
effect: When you are hit (after Hit effects), spend any amount of Gauge for +2 Armor per Gauge spent.
When you are hit (after Hit effects), spend any amount of Force for +2 Armor per Force spent.
HIT: Push 2.
